_help: Copy this file, rename it (no leading underscore) and fill in your decks. Files starting with an underscore are never loaded.
The loader ignores top-level keys that start with an underscore (this _help), but rejects unknown keys inside decks and items.
`ref` is yours and must never change: it is how a second load finds the item to update instead of duplicating it. `slug` does the same for a deck.
kind: pointer, formula, section, definition, mnemonic, case_law or cloze. The fields of each kind are listed in docs/F-15-ROLLOUT.md (W11, seed files).
importance: mandatory (must know), important or bullet. rights_status: original (our own words), licensed, institute_material, third_party_claimed or unknown. `unknown` blocks publishing.
Write every card in our own words (Q-F15-4). Markdown and $KaTeX$ are allowed, up to 4,000 characters per field.
change_kind on an edited item: typo or clarify (no effect on students' schedules), substantive or amendment (R2 sync brings the card back).
chapter_key is the stable key of the chapter in the syllabus (the last part of /courses/<course>/<level>/<subject>/<chapter>).
